faculty.name: Robyn B. Adams
faculty.summary: Holds an assistant professorship in media and communication; the department profile provides no research description.
faculty.summary_zh: 任职于媒体与传播学院助理教授；系所简介未提供研究方向说明。

faculty.name: Maggie Bennett-Brown
faculty.summary: Studies affectionate communication in romantic relationships and its links to sexual satisfaction, mental and physical health, and underlying biological correlates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的情感表达传播，及其与性满足、身心健康和相关生物学指标之间的联系。

faculty.name: Shannon Bichard
faculty.summary: Studies the social impact of new and social media on groups such as children and older adults, plus advertising framing and persuasion, via content analysis and surveys.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新媒体与社交媒体对儿童、老年人等群体的社会影响，以及广告框架与说服，主要采用内容分析与问卷调查。

faculty.name: Erik P. Bucy
faculty.summary: Studies visual and nonverbal dimensions of news and politics, user engagement with media technologies, and normative theories of media and democracy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻与政治中的视觉和非语言维度、用户对媒介技术的参与，以及媒介与民主的规范理论。

faculty.name: Coy Callison
faculty.summary: Studies how source and message factors interact with audience cognition, with funded work on science, extreme weather, and water-scarcity communication for agricultural producers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究信源与信息因素如何与受众认知相互作用，并主持关于科学、极端天气及面向农业生产者的水资源短缺传播的资助项目。

faculty.name: Seung Woo Chae
faculty.summary: Studies digital journalism and communication on video-based platforms such as YouTube and Twitch, informed by industry experience in Korean broadcasting.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字新闻以及YouTube、Twitch等视频平台上的传播，并结合其在韩国广播电视业的从业经验。

faculty.name: Todd Chambers
faculty.summary: Studies media management and economics, including ownership, radio market structure and programming, Spanish-language radio, media sales, and sports media.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介管理与媒介经济，包括所有权、广播市场结构与节目编排、西班牙语广播、媒体销售及体育媒体。

faculty.name: Minhee Choi
faculty.summary: Examines the effects of advocacy messages and communication strategies on public health issues, drawing on prior nonprofit public relations work.
faculty.summary_zh: 考察倡导性信息与传播策略在公共卫生议题上的效果，并借鉴其非营利组织公关工作经验。

faculty.name: Ioana Coman
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals, organizations, media, and officials interact in risk and crisis communication around outbreaks, vaccines, terrorism, disasters, and climate change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个人、组织、媒体与官员在疫情、疫苗、恐怖袭击、灾害和气候变化等风险与危机传播中的互动。

faculty.name: Megan Condis
faculty.summary: Examines how games and technologies come to signify racialized, gendered, and sexualized identities, through cultural critique and historical study of gaming culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过文化批判与历史研究，考察游戏与技术如何被解读为种族化、性别化和性向化的身份符号。

faculty.name: Glenn Cummins
faculty.summary: Studies media psychology in sports and entertainment media using psychophysiology, eye tracking, and continuous response measurement.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用心理生理测量、眼动追踪与连续反应测量，研究体育与娱乐媒介中的媒介心理。

faculty.name: Lyombe Eko
faculty.summary: Studies comparative and international communication law, ethics, and new media policy, along with collective memory and postcolonial politics in Africa, France, and the US.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究比较与国际传播法、传播伦理与新媒体政策，以及非洲、法国与美国的集体记忆和后殖民政治。

faculty.name: Sherice Gearhart
faculty.summary: Examines how people use traditional and social media to form and express opinions, applying spiral of silence theory online with quantitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用定量方法考察人们如何借助传统媒体与社交媒体形成并表达意见，并将沉默的螺旋理论应用于网络环境。

faculty.name: Melissa Gotlieb
faculty.summary: Studies emergent citizenship practices such as political consumerism and digital political expression, and how they shape young citizens' political participation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究政治消费主义与数字政治表达等新兴公民实践，及其如何塑造年轻公民的政治参与。

faculty.name: Mark A. Gring
faculty.summary: Researches rhetoric and political communication, with further interests in religion and classical pedagogy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究修辞与政治传播，并关注宗教与古典教学法。

faculty.name: Amy N. Heuman
faculty.summary: Studies cultural identity negotiation, intercultural relationships, and community mobilization for social justice through critical and feminist lenses, notably in Texas Latinx colonias.
faculty.summary_zh: 以批判与女性主义视角研究文化身份协商、跨文化关系及社区为社会正义的动员，尤其关注德州拉丁裔聚居区。

faculty.name: William T. Howe
faculty.summary: Studies organizational communication in high-reliability organizations, focusing on military and veteran identity, reintegration, and communication under risk.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高可靠性组织中的组织传播，聚焦军人与退伍军人身份、重新融入社会以及风险情境下的传播。

faculty.name: Patrick Hughes
faculty.summary: Examines how communication shapes learning, relationships, and adaptation, including communication competence, instructional communication, and family business succession.
faculty.summary_zh: 考察传播如何影响学习、关系与适应，涵盖传播能力、教学传播及家族企业传承。

faculty.name: Kulsawasd "Bo" Jitkajornwanich
faculty.summary: Applies computational and data science methods such as spatio-temporal data mining and GIS to environmental monitoring, disaster management, and social media.
faculty.summary_zh: 将时空数据挖掘、地理信息系统等计算与数据科学方法应用于环境监测、灾害管理和社交媒体。

faculty.name: Kerk F. Kee
faculty.summary: Studies the diffusion of innovations such as big data cyberinfrastructure and AI in scientific organizations, and the spread of health and pro-environmental behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大数据网络基础设施、人工智能等创新在科学组织中的扩散，以及健康与亲环境行为的传播。

faculty.name: Jenna LaFreniere
faculty.summary: Studies interpersonal and family communication, focusing on conflict and its impacts, including divorce, emotion work, and privacy in health disclosure.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际与家庭传播，聚焦冲突及其影响，包括离婚、情绪劳动以及健康信息披露中的隐私。

faculty.name: Catherine "Katie" Langford
faculty.summary: Researches rhetoric and political communication, with a specialization in legal rhetoric.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究修辞与政治传播，专长为法律修辞。

faculty.name: S. Austin Lee
faculty.summary: Studies how people communicate with, trust, and respond to AI and robots, including health uses and misinformation, using experiments, surveys, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用实验、调查与计算方法，研究人们如何与人工智能和机器人交流、信任并作出反应，包括健康应用与虚假信息。

faculty.name: Bryan McLaughlin
faculty.summary: Studies how citizens process political narratives and how problematic news consumption relates to political hostility, deliberation, and well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公民如何处理政治叙事，以及问题性新闻消费与政治敌意、协商和身心健康之间的关系。

faculty.name: Charles "Chas" Monge
faculty.summary: Studies the social and moral psychology of online interaction, including toxicity in gaming and computer-mediated communication, using lab, survey, and field experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用实验室、调查与田野实验，研究网络互动的社会与道德心理，包括游戏与计算机中介传播中的恶意行为。

faculty.name: Robert Peaslee
faculty.summary: Studies fan cultures, film, superheroes, and media and place, including screen tourism sites such as Hobbiton, through cultural and media-anthropological lenses.
faculty.summary_zh: 以文化研究与媒介人类学视角研究粉丝文化、电影、超级英雄以及媒介与地方，包括霍比屯等影视旅游地。

faculty.name: David D. Perlmutter
faculty.summary: Researches visual, political, and health communication and media and public policy, and writes widely on academic careers and higher education.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉传播、政治传播、健康传播以及媒介与公共政策，并广泛撰写学术职业与高等教育相关文章。

faculty.name: Narissra M. Punyanunt-Carter
faculty.summary: Examines how romantic relationships, digital intimacy, deception, and identity evolve in technology-saturated settings, integrating interpersonal and media effects theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 融合人际传播与媒介效果理论，考察恋爱关系、数字亲密、欺骗与身份在技术高度渗透环境中的演变。

faculty.name: Melissa Santillana
faculty.summary: Studies international media flows, feminist activism and protest movements, and digital inequality, with a focus on Mexico and Latin American television.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究国际媒介流动、女性主义行动与抗议运动以及数字不平等，聚焦墨西哥与拉丁美洲电视。

faculty.name: Trent Seltzer
faculty.summary: Studies organization-public relationship management in political, health, and consumer contexts, and strategic communication that promotes adolescent mental health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究政治、健康与消费情境中的组织—公众关系管理，以及促进青少年心理健康的战略传播。

faculty.name: Prerna Shah
faculty.summary: Studies health and environmental risk communication, including secondary risk theory, diet-related messaging, climate anxiety, and virtual reality and emerging technology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康与环境风险传播，包括次级风险理论、饮食相关信息、气候焦虑以及虚拟现实与新兴技术。

faculty.name: Maria Shpeer
faculty.summary: Studies the intersection of identity, culture, and politics in media in international contexts, using qualitative and quantitative social scientific methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用定性与定量社会科学方法，研究国际语境下媒介中身份、文化与政治的交织。

faculty.name: Miglena Sternadori
faculty.summary: Studies frames and stereotypes in media content, gender and sexuality in media, and how implicit biases shape media processing, using experiments among other methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介内容中的框架与刻板印象、媒介中的性别与性，以及内隐偏见如何影响媒介信息加工，主要采用实验等方法。

faculty.name: Robert Stewart
faculty.summary: Researches interpersonal and instructional communication, communication and religion, and public speaking and professional presentations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人际传播与教学传播、传播与宗教，以及公共演讲与职业演示。

faculty.name: Anastasia A Vishnevskaya
faculty.summary: Studies how media narratives and visual primes about marginalized groups, such as Muslim women, shape public opinion, using qualitative, quantitative, and mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用定性、定量与混合方法，研究关于穆斯林女性等边缘群体的媒介叙事和视觉启动如何影响公众舆论。

faculty.name: Buduo Wang
faculty.summary: Examines how people process and resist health messages online, including those from social media influencers and AI, using experiments and surveys.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用实验与调查，考察人们如何在网络环境中加工并抵制健康信息，包括来自社交媒体网红和人工智能的信息。

faculty.name: Kent Wilkinson
faculty.summary: Studies international communication and U.S. Hispanic/Latinx media, including Spanish-language television history, language in media markets, and Hispanic health communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究国际传播与美国西语裔/拉丁裔媒体，包括西班牙语电视史、媒介市场中的语言问题以及西语裔健康传播。

faculty.name: Luna Wu
faculty.summary: Studies patient-provider communication, telehealth, and digital health interventions that shape health decisions, using surveys, experiments, and statistical modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用调查、实验与统计建模，研究医患沟通、远程医疗以及影响健康决策的数字健康干预。

faculty.name: Shan Xu
faculty.summary: Studies the reciprocal, dynamic effects of AI, social media, and media multitasking on health, well-being, and productivity using longitudinal, EMA, and machine learning methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用纵向研究、生态瞬时评估和机器学习方法，研究人工智能、社交媒体与媒介多任务对健康、幸福感和生产力的动态互惠影响。

faculty.name: Michael J. Faris
faculty.summary: Studies digital rhetoric and literacy practices, feminist and queer rhetorics, soundwriting, and composition and technical communication pedagogy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字修辞与读写实践、女性主义与酷儿修辞、声音写作，以及写作与技术传播教学。

faculty.name: Priyanka (Priya) Ganguly
faculty.summary: Examines rhetorics of health and medicine in transnational communication design on issues like menstruation, maternal nutrition, and abortion, using interviews and focus groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用访谈与焦点小组，考察跨国传播设计中的健康与医学修辞，涉及月经、孕产妇营养与堕胎等议题。

faculty.name: T J Geiger II
faculty.summary: Studies religious, feminist, and scientific rhetorics and deliberation, including evangelicalism and #MeToo, through rhetorical history and analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过修辞史与修辞分析，研究宗教、女性主义与科学修辞及公共协商，包括福音派与#MeToo。

faculty.name: Kellie M. Gray
faculty.summary: Studies visual and digital rhetoric and technical communication pedagogy, including critical text mining of emoji use in #BlackLivesMatter.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉修辞、数字修辞与技术传播教学，包括对#BlackLivesMatter中表情符号使用的批判性文本挖掘。

faculty.name: Steve Holmes
faculty.summary: Applies material rhetoric and embodiment to digital texts like videogames and social media, and studies ethics of content moderation through qualitative research.
faculty.summary_zh: 将物质修辞与具身理论应用于电子游戏、社交媒体等数字文本，并通过质性研究探讨内容审核伦理。

faculty.name: Lisa L. Phillips
faculty.summary: Studies environmental, Indigenous, and feminist rhetorics of sensation and embodiment, focusing on public protests over environmental injustice in marginalized communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境、原住民与女性主义修辞中的感官与具身，聚焦边缘社群针对环境不正义的公共抗议。

faculty.name: Beau S. Pihlaja
faculty.summary: Studies how communication technologies shape intercultural collaboration in global technical communication, using activity theory, actor-network theory, observation, and interviews.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用活动理论、行动者网络理论、观察与访谈，研究传播技术如何影响全球技术传播中的跨文化协作。

faculty.name: Rich Rice
faculty.summary: Researches composition and rhetoric, new media, online writing instruction, and intercultural communication, with current work on generative AI and grant writing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究写作与修辞、新媒体、在线写作教学与跨文化传播，目前关注生成式人工智能与基金申请写作。

faculty.name: Geoffrey Sauer
faculty.summary: Studies the history of publishing through cultural and rhetorical theory, alongside usability, user experience, usable genres, and learning management systems as material rhetoric.
faculty.summary_zh: 以文化与修辞理论研究出版史，并关注可用性、用户体验、可用文类以及作为物质修辞的学习管理系统。

faculty.name: Brian Still
faculty.summary: Focuses on usability and eye-tracking research, including development of affordable and assistive eye-tracking hardware and software.
faculty.summary_zh: 专注于可用性与眼动追踪研究，包括开发低成本及辅助性的眼动追踪软硬件。

faculty.name: Imari Cheyne Tetu
faculty.summary: Studies disability, accessibility, and UX research in learning experience design, focusing on belonging for disabled and nontraditional students in hybrid courses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习体验设计中的残障、无障碍与用户体验，关注残障及非传统学生在混合式课程中的归属感。

faculty.name: Jason Tham
faculty.summary: Studies design thinking, UX and usability, collaborative writing including in virtual reality, and AI user experience within technical communication pedagogy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究设计思维、用户体验与可用性、协作写作（包括虚拟现实中的协作写作）以及技术传播教学中的人工智能用户体验。

faculty.name: Scott Weedon
faculty.summary: Studies writing in engineering disciplines, rhetorical genre studies, and rhetorics of science and medicine, including gender-inclusive research writing and informed consent.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工程学科写作、修辞文类研究以及科学与医学修辞，包括性别包容的科研写作与知情同意。
